blocks.raw: <Tip>**"Office = 4–6 ACH, Kitchen = 15 ACH, OR = 15–20 ACH (positive pressure)."** These are the three most-tested categories. Operating rooms are the most stringent (highest ACH, special pressure control, HEPA). Kitchens come next. Offices are baseline. Memorize this hierarchy.</Tip>
